topic: Inter-hospital transfer communication in mental health
usual_baseline: Transfer letters are often missing: none in 8 transfers [3148], 17–40% [3243]. SBAR handover not documented in 62% [3462]. Physical health is the weak point: complete notes 7/12 [3341], NEWS charts sent 17 of 42, oral intake 13 [3429]. Legal paperwork is good: MHA paperwork 36/36 [3429].
fix_that_works: Raising the need for a transfer letter at governance and management meetings: transfer or discharge letter 0% to 88% [3148]. Samples were small (8) and differed between cycles.
fix_that_fails: A structured preadmission checklist made no difference to information sought (n=5 to 2); physical, mental health and safeguarding updates were still needed [3409].
consultant_advice: Samples here are tiny and few loops closed. Legal paperwork is already done. Measure physical health handover, such as NEWS charts, allergies and medication, and whether issues on arrival led to return or delayed actions.
